title.en: Approximation and expressivity — what the theorems do and do not say
title.zh: 逼近与表达能力——定理说了什么，又没说什么

en.a: Approximation, stability, circuit complexity, and infinite-width limits answer different questions; none alone predicts a trained LLM's behavior.
en.b: The final appendix lesson is a scope map. It records conditions on universal approximation, Lipschitzness, TC0/chain-of-thought, NNGP/NTK, and μP rather than turning them into slogans.

zh.a: 逼近、稳定性、电路复杂度和无限宽度极限回答的是不同的问题；没有任何一个能单独预测训练好的大语言模型的行为。
zh.b: 最后的附录课程是一张范围图。它记录了关于通用逼近、Lipschitz 连续性、TC0/思维链、NNGP/NTK 以及 μP 的条件，而不是将它们变成口号。
